name: Laravel Mass Assignment via Empty $guarded
attack_scenario: Attacker adds is_admin=1 to the registration form; with $guarded=[] the field is fillable and persisted, granting admin on signup.
negative_test_hint: submit the registration form with the extra parameter "is_admin=1" and assert the created account is not an administrator

exemplar.explanation: An empty $guarded array makes every attribute mass-assignable, so Model::create($request->all()) or ->fill() lets the client set any column including is_admin/role. Define an explicit $fillable allowlist of user-settable attributes instead.
